figurative_meaning_en: Profound in meaning and characterized by serious, solemn words
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার বক্তৃতা গুরুগম্ভীর ছিল, সকলকে চিন্তায় মগ্ন করে দিল।
এই গুরুগম্ভীর বর্ণনা পাঠকের মনে গভীর ছাপ ফেলে।
example_sentences_in_english: His speech was profound and solemn, immersing everyone in thought.
This profound description leaves a deep impression on the reader's mind.
note: Often used in literary and philosophical contexts in Bengali literature
